verdict.rationale: Carta's documented AI path is official Claude MCP plugins. They let users ask natural-language questions about cap tables, SAFEs, valuations and fund data, and generate tear sheets, budgets, financial statements and investor-reporting PDFs. These insights are produced in an external LLM client (Claude), not inside the Carta product itself. missing for 10: evidence of native in-product AI insights or suggestions, proactive recommendations surfaced in Carta's UI, and independent or hands-on corroboration of output quality.
